description: This file implements a CodeParser class responsible for parsing code files into semantic code blocks, supporting multiple languages and markdown, with chunking and fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: CodeParser
classes.description: Implements the ICodeParser interface, providing methods to parse files into code blocks with support for multiple languages and markdown.

methods.name: parseFile
methods.description: Asynchronously reads and parses a code file into code blocks, supporting content options and error handling.

methods.name: isSupportedLanguage
methods.description: Checks if a file extension corresponds to a supported language.

methods.name: createFileHash
methods.description: Generates a SHA-256 hash for the file content.

methods.name: parseContent
methods.description: Parses the content of a file into code blocks, handling markdown, fallback chunking, and language parsing.

methods.name: _performFallbackChunking
methods.description: Performs chunking of large text content by lines as a fallback method.

methods.name: _chunkLeafNodeByLines
methods.description: Chunks a tree-sitter node's text into code blocks by lines.

methods.name: processMarkdownSection
methods.description: Processes sections of markdown content into code blocks, with chunking support.

methods.name: parseMarkdownContent
methods.description: Parses markdown content, extracting headers and sections, and converting them into code blocks.
